answer: Each identity locks a 40-credit bond and a jade seal in the public graph. Each epoch a beacon draws random raven auditors to check each vertex; failed audits burn the bond, and a raven clearing a later-exposed fake loses its bond. First identity costs 40, the k-th 40+5(k-1); 1,000 fake vertices cost 2,537,500 against a 40,000 pool. Rented ravens fail: draws stay anonymous until audits close; honest agents pay 40 once, keeping their full share.
